The governed face is the published catalog text; the judgment is whether every spelling the two reference files now teach is one the platform accepts, and whether the two ratchet deletions remove nothing the files do not still say. Written 2026-10-14T06:03Z.

### ① Derived judgments

- `examples-flows.md:41` — `'{TODAY()}'` → `'{today}'` at an `update_record` filter operand: `today` is a query placeholder (`DATE_MACRO_TOKENS`, `packages/spec/src/data/date-macros.zod.ts:126`, read by `isKnownFilterToken`), `TODAY()` is that file's documented unknown-token example. Correct.
- `examples-flows.md:119–120` — the three `'{TODAY() + N}'` windows become one CEL envelope pair `{ dialect: 'cel', source: 'isoDate(daysFromNow(7))' }` / `isoDate(daysFromNow(8))` with a comment naming the 30/31 and 60/61 tiers: a filter operand is a value slot that takes an envelope (`flow-value-slot-template.ts` "A CRUD node's filter operands — the query placeholders stay": each operand is a value slot, a whole-string placeholder passes, every other `{…}` string is refused with its CEL spelling); `isoDate(daysFromNow(N))` is the module's own date prescription (`:85–86`), `daysFromNow` bare-callable (`packages/formula/src/validate.ts:1271`). Correct; the parent's `SKILL.md:276` writes the same envelope at a filter.
- `examples-flows.md:126–129` — the sentence "a `cel\`…\`` envelope is not evaluated there and would be compared as a literal object" said the inverse of the contract and is replaced by "Each bound is a CEL value envelope … evaluated before the query; any `{…}` token but a query placeholder such as `{today}` is refused there (`expression-invalid`)" — the value-slot module's rule, and `EXPRESSION_INVALID` is `packages/lint/src/authoring-rules.ts:542`. A same-class site outside the card's enumerated lines, inside the claimed file; correct and necessary (the old sentence taught an author to avoid the one spelling that works). `:79` — "`{record.*}` interpolation" → "a `record.*` CEL value envelope". Correct.
- `state-machines-and-approvals.md:120` — `filter: { id: '{record.id}' }` → `filter: { id: { dialect: 'cel', source: 'record.id' } }`: the parent's spelling (`SKILL.md:276`). `:334` — the cheat sheet's "`{…}` template" surface becomes "CEL envelope / `{{ }}` hole": the two live surfaces (value slot, text slot) in place of the retired one; `record` / `previous` columns unchanged. Correct.
- Deletions, read against the head: `examples-flows.md:131–132` ("Exactly one of `offsetDays` … or `withinDays` … is required") — carried by the same file's code comment at `:97`, now "— or (exactly one) — `withinDays: 30`"; `state-machines-and-approvals.md:131` (the comment "Without them BOTH branches would execute (unguarded edges run in parallel)") — the surviving comment line "Decision branches: mutually-exclusive edge `condition` predicates." and the file's `:104–107` carry the rule. Nothing leaves the files' teaching.
- Ratchet: `examples-flows.md` 1426 → 1421 tokens (ceiling 1436), `state-machines-and-approvals.md` 5562 → 5555 (ceiling 5569); no ceiling moved; the authored bundle 144059 → 144047 (`Lint & Repo Gates` runs the ratchet). `Fixes #23374` is the body's only closing keyword (#22585 and #23355 carry no closing verb); `Clause-②: no` is correct — published text narrowed to the contract, no `packages/**`.

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/23374-automation-references-envelopes.md` — `'@objectstack/skills': patch`. Correct: both files ship in the catalog tarball. Each sentence of the changeset is judged against the diff in the ACCEPT on the card (prose face).

### ③ Boundary flags

- Dispatch assumption falsified by the dev: the two reference files ARE declared inputs of `@objectstack/rest`'s repo tests — `scripts/cross-package-test-inputs.mjs:1301` declares `skills/**` whole (read on `main`); the dev ran `test:repo` (exit 0, 213 passed) and the three `packages/spec` skills readers. Accepted; the seat's reading was wrong.
- Dev flag — two same-class sites outside the enumerated lines corrected in the claimed files (`examples-flows.md:127`, `state-machines-and-approvals.md:334`), named in the PR body. Accepted (same defect class, same file surface).
- Dev flag — the three windows collapsed to one envelope pair plus a comment (six envelopes would have cost ~66 tokens against a headroom of 10). Accepted: the pattern is shown once and the tiers are named.
- Dev flag — `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` NOT MEASURED locally (every package's `dist/`): `Lint & Repo Gates` runs it. Accepted.
- Out of scope (noted, no card): `dispatch-gates --commands` derives neither `check:skill-docs` nor `check:skill-examples` for a `skills/**/references/*.md` diff; CI's unfiltered lint lane runs both. `open_questions`: none.

## 维护者速读(终稿)· PR #23402 · head `cee1d67425` · Tier H(`skills/**`)

skills 席 1(`session_013zGKMG1cRedVzWtqGGGZW9`,huangyiirene),写于 2026-10-14T06:03Z。席内契约复核 PASS 记录在本 PR,ACCEPT 在卡 #23374;本 PR 保持 draft,⛔ 席位不翻 ready、不入队。

### 改了什么

automation 技能随包发布的两个参考文件补上 #22585(PR #23355)没覆盖的同类修正:`references/examples-flows.md` 里 CRUD `filter` 的 `'{TODAY()}'` 改为查询占位符 `'{today}'`,三段 `'{TODAY() + N}'` 日期窗口改为一对 CEL 值信封 `isoDate(daysFromNow(7))` / `isoDate(daysFromNow(8))`(30/31、60/61 两档在注释里点名),把一句写反了的话(「信封在 filter 里不会被求值、会被当字面量比较」)改成平台的真实规则(信封先求值;除查询占位符外的 `{…}` 一律被拒);`references/state-machines-and-approvals.md` 的审批示例 `filter: { id: '{record.id}' }` 改为信封,时间词速查表里退役的「`{…}` 模板」改为「CEL 信封 / `{{ }}` 洞」两种现行表面。两文件各删一句别处仍在的复述来支付,token 都在上限内且比改前更小;附 `@objectstack/skills` patch changeset。

### 为什么改

这两个文件逐字随 `@objectstack/skills` 装进每个项目;示例里的写法一抄就被 `objectstack validate` 拒收,而旧的那句还告诉作者「别用信封」——恰好是唯一能用的写法。

### 风险与代价(含回滚)

- 纯文本改动,不碰 `packages/**`。风险只有「教错新写法」一种:每个新写法我在 `main` 上对到了源码(值槽模块的 filter 节、`date-macros` 的 `today`、formula 的 `daysFromNow`、lint 的 `expression-invalid`),与父 PR #23355 在 `SKILL.md:276` 写的信封一致。
- dev 把三段窗口收成一对信封加一行注释(六个信封要约 66 token,余量只有 10);示例仍完整演示一档,其余两档点名。
- 回滚 = revert 本 PR;changeset 未消费前删除即无痕。

### 席位意见

同意落地。① 文本只收窄到已发布契约,没有放宽;② dev 顺手改掉了枚举行之外同类的两处(反话一句、速查表标签一处),都在认领的文件面内,属同缺陷类,PR 正文逐条点名;③ 派发令里「这两个文件不是 rest 测试的输入」是我读错了——`cross-package-test-inputs.mjs:1301` 把 `skills/**` 整体声明为输入,dev 已照实跑了 `test:repo`(213 通过)。

### 你要做的

一个动作:对本 PR **Approve**(`skills/**` 是 Tier H,需要你一次授权批准;批准后席位经中继落地)。
